description: Return alternatives and works-with listings for one catalog tool, identified by its exact slug (trimmed, case-sensitive). Alternatives are other listings in the same category or from the same publisher. Works-with links connect, for example, an Apify Actor to the official Apify MCP server, or a browser-oriented Actor to a browser MCP. This is a small catalog graph, not a claim that the tools are interchangeable or officially integrated. Use this after search_tools or get_tool when you want nearby options. If the slug is missing, the tool errors with {"error":"not_found","slug":...}. Optional limit defaults to 5 and is capped at 12. No authentication. This server allows 60 MCP requests per minute.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of listings in each of the alternatives and works_with lists. Default 5, maximum 12.

slug.description: Exact catalog slug after trim, case-sensitive, for example eodhd or sam-gov-opportunities.
